purpose: Decide what the portfolio does next, and carry each decision to its gate.
stance: standing on two legs, forward lean, weight committed, mid-stride

body.archetype: angular wedge body, flat planes meeting on one clean diagonal, no soft curves
body.attachment: a pair of shears carried at its shoulder, blades open, the cutting edge continuous with its own diagonal

body.archetype: tall and narrow, a body of nested brass barrels telescoping out of one another, weathered and unpolished, each section a little narrower than the one below it
body.attachment: its whole upper body extended and sighting on something past the edge of frame, one lens catching the light at the far end
